# ProductSharpener — Jenny Kan

> Jenny Kan is a product strategist and innovation consultant based in Amsterdam. She helps start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise teams sharpen their value proposition and product direction through focused workshops and sprints.

## Who she is

Jenny Kan leads product strategy, experience design and innovation. She has more than 15 years of experience helping organisations turn complex customer and business challenges into clear product direction, new propositions and tangible outcomes. Her clients include ServiceNow, Nike, BMW, ASML, Aviva, DHL and the European Commission.

She co-founded Product Pulse (an online product community), created KnowTheAct (a plain-English EU AI Act guide for consumers), and developed the AI Amplifier Framework to help product teams connect strategy, building and validation.

## What she offers

- **Foundation Sprint Workshop** (2 days, €2,400) — Value proposition, USPs and GTM messaging, sharpened with your team.
- **Strategy Jam** (half or full day, €1,200) — Joint vision alignment across stakeholders.
- **Design Sprint** (5 days, €5,500) — Discovery, research and a working prototype built alongside your team.
- **Innovation Sprint** — A new proposition, MVP or prototype built with your team.
- **Customer Journey Mapping** — See exactly where customers stall and where the value is hiding.
- **AI Opportunity Mapping** — A ranked shortlist of AI use cases worth building.
- **Interactive Prototype** — A core experience you can click through and test with real users.
- **Product Roadmap** — Priorities, sequencing and dependencies your team can commit to.

## Skills and expertise

- Design Thinking & AI Product Strategy
- Design Sprints, Co-Innovation Workshops, Foundation Sprints
- AI Native Product Vision & PRD
- AI Opportunity Mapping, Service Blue Printing, User Journey Mapping
- AI-Assisted Prototyping (Lovable, Cursor)
- MVP Definition, GTM Strategy
- Value Proposition Design, Commercial Messaging
